en.headline: Porsche on test plates catches fire on Tai Hang Road
en.dek: The driver stopped and left the car after smoke rose from the rear near Tiger Balm Garden; firefighters put out the blaze and nobody was hurt.
body: A Porsche sports car carrying red trade plates caught fire while travelling along Tai Hang Road towards Jardine's Lookout at about 7.52am on Sunday, near Tiger Balm Garden.
The driver stopped and left the vehicle after smoke appeared at the rear. Firefighters extinguished the fire. Nobody was injured. The rear of the car was burnt.
Officers said the car appeared to have leaked engine oil, and police covered the spill with sawdust. The cause of the fire is under investigation.

zh.headline: 大坑道T牌保時捷行駛中起火 無人受傷
zh.dek: 一輛掛紅色試車牌的保時捷週日早上在大坑道近虎豹別墅車尾冒煙起火，司機停車逃生，消防救熄，無人受傷。
body: 週日早上約7時52分，一輛掛有紅色試車牌的保時捷跑車沿大坑道往渣甸山方向行駛，至虎豹別墅對開時車尾突然冒煙。
司機立即停車並落車離開。消防到場將火勢撲熄，事件中無人受傷，車尾焚毀。
涉事跑車懸疑漏出機油，警員用木糠掩蓋油污。起火原因有待調查。
